items.html: And the matter is more fully explained thus: it has already been explained that from these kings were sorted the discernments fit for Atik, for AA, and for AVI [Aba ve Ima] of Atzilut. Indeed, in their posterior there was some breaking in them, yet not actual death, which is the shell, but only a diminution of light; and through this those posteriors fell below their place, within holiness itself, and there is no actual dross in them, which is death. However, in the portion of ZON of Atzilut, although all the Malchuts in each of their Sefirot were sorted from these kings of the above name BON, some sparks nevertheless remained in them that were not sorted, and they are mixed inside the shells and the dross; therefore actual death applies to these. It thus follows that all the shells cling to ZON alone, and not from Ima upward.
